Fundaz3D · Help

Navigation & Gestures

Viewport

  • 1-finger drag — Orbit camera
  • 2-finger drag — Pan camera
  • Pinch — Zoom
  • Tap object — Select
  • Long-press + drag — Box-select
  • Tap gizmo axis — Snap view
  • Tap gizmo center — Persp / Ortho

Keyframes

  • Every property has a ◆ diamond button
  • Tap ◆ to insert/remove key at playhead
  • Once keyed, changing auto-inserts

Timeline

  • Tap key — Select (shift = multi)
  • Drag key — Move frames
  • ◀ ▶ gizmo — Nudge ±1 frame
  • Long-press empty — Range-select

Render

  • Requires at least one camera
  • Renders exactly what the camera sees
  • Multiple cameras → one file per camera
  • Duration × FPS = frames to render
  • Two-phase: pre-render → real-time playback

Multi-Select

  • Long-press viewport → box-select
  • Drag gizmo → only selected move
  • Local positions preserved (no reparent)

Lights

  • Realistic PBR intensities — colors stay saturated
  • Every light property has ◆ keyframe
  • Point / Sun / Spot / Area / Ambient
